## Data Preparation

Two samples are analysed:

- **Main analysis: fully registered sample** (`data_participants.csv`, `data_illusion.csv`; objects `data_ppt`, `data_ig`, `ig_scores`): all registered exclusion criteria, including the space bar check, and no unregistered preprocessing.
- **Sensitivity analysis: unregistered** (`data_participants_unregistered.csv`, `data_illusion_unregistered.csv`; objects `data_ppt_unreg`, `data_ig_unreg`): all registered exclusion criteria except the space bar check (see the cleaning report). Extreme trials and participants with extreme congruent error rates are additionally excluded in the unregistered analysis (see *Unregistered Analysis*).

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggdist)
library(ggside)
library(easystats)
library(patchwork)
library(psych)

set.seed(3)

prepare_ig <- function(data) {
  data |>
    mutate(
        Block = as.factor(Block),
        Illusion_Effect = fct_relevel(as.factor(Illusion_Effect), "Incongruent", "Congruent"),
        Response_Correct = as.factor(Response_Correct)
    )
}

# Main analysis (fully registered sample)
data_ppt <- read.csv("../data/data_participants.csv")
data_ig <- read.csv("../data/data_illusion.csv") |> prepare_ig()

# Sensitivity analysis (unregistered)
data_ppt_unreg <- read.csv("../data/data_participants_unregistered.csv")
data_ig_unreg <- read.csv("../data/data_illusion_unregistered.csv") |> prepare_ig()

# First language (from the Prolific demographic exports; added by preprocessing.R)
native <- read.csv("../data/rawdata_participants.csv")[c("Participant", "Native_English")]
if (!"Native_English" %in% names(data_ppt)) data_ppt$Native_English <- native$Native_English[match(data_ppt$Participant, native$Participant)]
if (!"Native_English" %in% names(data_ppt_unreg)) data_ppt_unreg$Native_English <- native$Native_English[match(data_ppt_unreg$Participant, native$Participant)]
```

The Stage 1 protocol specified native English speakers, but recruitment also admitted participants whose primary (but not first) language was English. Non-native speakers: `r sum(!data_ppt$Native_English, na.rm = TRUE)` of `r nrow(data_ppt)` in the registered sample, and `r sum(!data_ppt_unreg$Native_English, na.rm = TRUE)` of `r nrow(data_ppt_unreg)` in the unregistered sample. A sensitivity analysis restricts the registered analysis to native speakers (see *Sensitivity Analyses*).



## PCS Score

### Computation

Mean subjective scale responses for item 4 (Taste) and item 10 (Post-session suggestion) are each generated from the combination of two responses which require processing prior to generating an overall subjective score.
The subjective score for item 4 is the mean of the responses to the (a)‘sour’ and (b)‘sweet’ sub-scales for the taste suggestion.
The subjective score for item 10 is the geometric mean (the square root of the product) of the responses to the (a) ‘urge’ and (b) ‘amnesia’ sub-scales for the post-session suggestion.

```{r}
pcs_items <- c("pcs_handslow", "pcs_mosquito", "pcs_magnetichands", "pcs_armrigidity", "pcs_tastescore", "pcs_postsessionsuggetsion", "pcs_armimmobile", "pcs_music", "pcs_negativehallucination", "pcs_amnesia")

compute_pcs <- function(data) {
  data$pcs_tastescore <- rowMeans(data[grepl("taste", names(data))])
  data$pcs_postsessionsuggetsion <- sqrt(data$pcs_urgepress * data$pcs_memorypress)
  data$PCS_Score <- rowMeans(data[, pcs_items], na.rm = TRUE)
  data
}

data_ppt_unreg <- compute_pcs(data_ppt_unreg)
data_ppt <- compute_pcs(data_ppt)
```



## Illusion Game Scores

### Computation

Scores are computed (1) for each illusion strength (Congruent, Mild, Strong) and difficulty (Easy, Hard) combination; (2) collapsing Mild and Strong ("Incongruent"); (3) collapsing Easy and Hard ("General"); and (4) collapsing both.

```{r}
compute_scores <- function(data_ig) {
  # Full stratification
  scores <- data_ig |>
      summarize(
          ErrorRate = sum(Error) / n(),
          IES = mean(RT[Response_Correct == "true"] / mean(Response_Correct == "true")),
          .by = c("Participant", "Illusion_Type", "Condition_Illusion", "Condition_Difficulty")
      ) |>
      pivot_wider(
          names_from = c("Illusion_Type", "Condition_Illusion", "Condition_Difficulty"),
          values_from = c("ErrorRate", "IES")
      )

  # Collapse Mild and Strong
  scores_incongruent <- data_ig |>
      filter(Condition_Illusion != "Congruent") |>
      summarize(
          ErrorRate = sum(Error) / n(),
          IES = mean(RT[Response_Correct == "true"] / mean(Response_Correct == "true")),
          .by = c("Participant", "Illusion_Type", "Condition_Difficulty")
      ) |>
      pivot_wider(
          names_from = c("Illusion_Type", "Condition_Difficulty"),
          values_from = c("ErrorRate", "IES")
      )
  names(scores_incongruent) <- str_replace_all(names(scores_incongruent), "_Hard", "_Incongruent_Hard")
  names(scores_incongruent) <- str_replace_all(names(scores_incongruent), "_Easy", "_Incongruent_Easy")
  scores <- full_join(scores, scores_incongruent, by = "Participant")

  # Collapse Easy and Hard
  scores_general <- data_ig |>
      summarize(
          ErrorRate = sum(Error) / n(),
          IES = mean(RT[Response_Correct == "true"] / mean(Response_Correct == "true")),
          .by = c("Participant", "Illusion_Type", "Condition_Illusion")
      ) |>
      pivot_wider(
          names_from = c("Illusion_Type", "Condition_Illusion"),
          values_from = c("ErrorRate", "IES")
      ) |>
    data_addsuffix(select=-Participant, pattern = "_General")
  scores <- full_join(scores, scores_general, by = "Participant")

  # Collapse both
  scores_incongruent_general <- data_ig |>
      filter(Condition_Illusion != "Congruent") |>
      summarize(
          ErrorRate = sum(Error) / n(),
          IES = mean(RT[Response_Correct == "true"] / mean(Response_Correct == "true")),
          .by = c("Participant", "Illusion_Type")
      ) |>
      pivot_wider(
          names_from = c("Illusion_Type"),
          values_from = c("ErrorRate", "IES")
      ) |>
     data_addsuffix(select=-Participant, pattern = "_Incongruent_General")
  full_join(scores, scores_incongruent_general, by = "Participant")
}

ig_scores_nospacebar <- compute_scores(data_ig_unreg)
ig_scores <- compute_scores(data_ig)
```

### Unregistered Analysis

- **Fully registered analysis** (`ig_scores`): the main analysis, with all registered exclusion criteria and no unregistered step. The manipulation check, descriptive statistics, reliability and correlation analyses below are reported for this sample.
- **Unregistered analysis** (`ig_scores_unreg`): a sensitivity analysis addressing the issues identified during analysis. It applies all registered criteria except the space bar check, plus two unregistered exclusions: (1) trials with RT < 0.2 s or > 5 s are removed; and (2) participants whose congruent error rate for a given illusion lies above the 97.5% highest density interval (HDI) of its distribution are excluded for that illusion (likely misunderstanding of the instructions, i.e., high error rates where the illusion makes the task easier).

`ig_scores_nospacebar` (all registered criteria except the space bar check, and no other deviation) is used to isolate the effect of the space bar check.

#### Trial-Level RT Filter (unregistered)

```{r}
ig_scores_trialfilter <- compute_scores(filter(data_ig_unreg, !RT_Outlier))
```

#### HDI Exclusion (unregistered)

The HDI exclusion is computed on the trial-filtered scores. Two versions are computed: (1) **congruent upper tail only**, used in the unregistered analysis; and (2) the **two-sided** procedure used in the initial Stage 2 submission (both tails of the congruent and incongruent error rates), reported as a sensitivity analysis only.

```{r}
hdi_flag <- function(scores, mode = c("congruent_upper", "two_sided")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  conds <- if (mode == "two_sided") c("Congruent", "Incongruent") else "Congruent"
  flags <- list()
  breakdown <- data.frame()
  for (illu in c("MullerLyer", "Ebbinghaus", "VerticalHorizontal")) {
    flagged <- c()
    for (cond in conds) {
      x <- scores[[paste0("ErrorRate_", illu, "_", cond, "_General")]]
      bounds <- bayestestR::hdi(na.omit(x), ci = 0.975)
      above <- scores$Participant[!is.na(x) & x > bounds$CI_high]
      below <- if (mode == "two_sided") scores$Participant[!is.na(x) & x < bounds$CI_low] else c()
      missing <- if (mode == "two_sided") scores$Participant[is.na(x)] else c()
      flagged <- c(flagged, above, below, missing)
      breakdown <- rbind(breakdown, data.frame(
        Illusion = illu, Condition = cond, HDI_low = bounds$CI_low, HDI_high = bounds$CI_high,
        n_above = length(above), n_below = length(below)
      ))
    }
    flags[[illu]] <- unique(flagged)
  }
  list(flags = flags, breakdown = breakdown)
}

apply_flags <- function(scores, flags) {
  for (illu in names(flags)) {
    scores[scores$Participant %in% flags[[illu]], str_detect(names(scores), illu)] <- NA
  }
  scores
}

hdi_cong <- hdi_flag(ig_scores_trialfilter, "congruent_upper")
hdi_two <- hdi_flag(ig_scores_trialfilter, "two_sided")

hdi_two$breakdown |>
  format_table() |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header("97.5% HDI bounds and number of participants flagged in each tail")

data.frame(
  Illusion = names(hdi_cong$flags),
  Congruent_Upper = sapply(hdi_cong$flags, length),
  Two_Sided = sapply(hdi_two$flags, length)
) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header("Number of participants excluded per illusion")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 8

vars <- names(ig_scores_trialfilter)[str_detect(names(ig_scores_trialfilter), "ErrorRate_.*_(Congruent|Incongruent)_General")]
ps <- list()
for (var in vars) {
  bounds <- bayestestR::hdi(na.omit(ig_scores_trialfilter[[var]]), ci = 0.975)
  ps[[var]] <- ggplot(ig_scores_trialfilter, aes(x = !!as.name(var))) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.015) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(bounds$CI_low, bounds$CI_high), color = "red") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
    ggtitle(paste("97.5% HDI for", var)) +
    theme_minimal()
}
wrap_plots(ps)
```

#### Unregistered Scores and Sensitivity Versions

`make_unreg()` builds the unregistered scores from a trial-level dataset, with each deviation switchable, so that each deviation can be removed one at a time (sensitivity analyses).

```{r}
make_unreg <- function(data, trial_filter = TRUE, hdi = c("congruent_upper", "two_sided", "none")) {
  hdi <- match.arg(hdi)
  if (trial_filter) data <- filter(data, !RT_Outlier)
  scores <- compute_scores(data)
  if (hdi != "none") scores <- apply_flags(scores, hdi_flag(scores, hdi)$flags)
  scores
}

ig_scores_unreg <- make_unreg(data_ig_unreg)

# Block-wise RT rule (initial submission): the block-specific rule, registered for error rates
# only, also applied to the RT criterion. Approximate, as participants excluded by the
# registered (participant-level) RT rule are not in the data.
data_ig_rtblock <- data_ig_unreg |>
  filter(!Participant %in% data_ppt_unreg$Participant[data_ppt_unreg$IG_Outlier_RTBlock_Full]) |>
  filter(!((Block == "B") & (Participant %in% data_ppt_unreg$Participant[data_ppt_unreg$IG_Outlier_RTBlock_Half])))

unreg_versions <- list(
  "Unregistered without the trial-level RT filter" = make_unreg(data_ig_unreg, trial_filter = FALSE),
  "Unregistered without the HDI exclusion" = make_unreg(data_ig_unreg, hdi = "none"),
  "Unregistered with the two-sided HDI exclusion (initial submission)" = make_unreg(data_ig_unreg, hdi = "two_sided"),
  "Unregistered with the block-wise RT rule (initial submission)" = make_unreg(data_ig_rtblock)
)

data.frame(
  Illusion = c("MullerLyer", "Ebbinghaus", "VerticalHorizontal"),
  N_Unregistered = sapply(c("MullerLyer", "Ebbinghaus", "VerticalHorizontal"),
                          function(illu) sum(!is.na(ig_scores_unreg[[paste0("ErrorRate_", illu, "_Incongruent_General")]])))
) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header("Number of participants per illusion in the unregistered analysis")
```

### Should we collapse across Mild and Strong, and Easy and Hard?

Following the registered protocol, Bayesian correlations are computed between the Mild and Strong conditions for each illusion and outcome. If the correlation is above .50, the two conditions are collapsed (i.e., the registered test uses the "Incongruent" score); otherwise they are analysed separately. The tables below show the registered analysis; the decision itself is made separately for each analysis (see *Registered Decision*).

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Mild vs. Strong


```{r}
corrs <- data.frame()
for (outcome in c("ErrorRate", "IES")) {
    for (ill_type in c("Ebbinghaus", "MullerLyer", "VerticalHorizontal")) {
       for (dif in c("Easy", "Hard")) {

         corrs <- correlation::correlation(
                ig_scores[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type,"_Mild", "_", dif )],
                ig_scores[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_Strong", "_", dif )],
                bayesian = TRUE
            ) |>
                mutate(Illusion = ill_type,
                       Outcome = outcome) |>
                rbind(corrs)
        }
    }
}

corrs2 <- data.frame()
for (outcome in c("ErrorRate", "IES")) {
    for (ill_type in c("Ebbinghaus", "MullerLyer", "VerticalHorizontal")) {
            corrs2 <- correlation::correlation(
                ig_scores[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_Mild_General")],
                ig_scores[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_Strong_General")],
                bayesian = TRUE
            ) |>
                mutate(Illusion = ill_type,
                       Outcome = outcome) |>
                rbind(corrs2)
        }
}



print_corrs <- function(t) {
  arrange(t, Illusion, Outcome, desc(rho)) |>
    mutate(Parameter1 = str_replace(Parameter1, "ErrorRate_|IES_", ""),
           Parameter1 = str_replace(Parameter1, paste0(Illusion, "_"), ""),
           Parameter2 = str_replace(Parameter2, "ErrorRate_|IES_", ""),
           Parameter2 = str_replace(Parameter2, paste0(Illusion, "_"), "")) |>
    datawizard::data_reorder(c("Illusion", "Outcome")) |>
    format_table() |>
    mutate(rho = as.numeric(rho)) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::data_color(
        columns = rho,
        fn = function(x) dplyr::case_when(
          x >= 0.5  ~ "lightgreen",
          .default   = "#ffabab"
        )
      )
}

print_corrs(rbind(corrs, corrs2))
```

#### Registered Decision

The decision uses the sample correlation (r) so that it is deterministic; the Bayesian estimates above are virtually identical.

```{r}
collapse_decision <- function(scores) {
  out <- data.frame()
  for (outcome in c("ErrorRate", "IES")) {
    for (ill_type in c("Ebbinghaus", "MullerLyer", "VerticalHorizontal")) {
      r <- cor(scores[[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_Mild_General")]],
               scores[[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_Strong_General")]],
               use = "complete.obs")
      out <- rbind(out, data.frame(Outcome = outcome, Illusion = ill_type, r = r, Collapse = r > 0.5))
    }
  }
  out
}

registered_vars <- function(decision) {
  unlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(decision)), function(i) {
    if (decision$Collapse[i]) {
      paste0(decision$Outcome[i], "_", decision$Illusion[i], "_Incongruent_General")
    } else {
      paste0(decision$Outcome[i], "_", decision$Illusion[i], c("_Mild_General", "_Strong_General"))
    }
  }))
}

analysis_scores <- c(
  list(
    "Fully registered" = ig_scores,
    "Unregistered" = ig_scores_unreg,
    "Registered, native English speakers only" = filter(ig_scores, Participant %in% data_ppt$Participant[data_ppt$Native_English %in% TRUE]),
    "Registered criteria without the space bar check (no other deviation)" = ig_scores_nospacebar
  ),
  unreg_versions
)

decisions <- lapply(analysis_scores, collapse_decision)

collapse_table <- bind_rows(decisions, .id = "Analysis")
saveRDS(collapse_table, "figures/table_collapse.rds")

collapse_table |>
  format_table() |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Analysis")
```

### Manipulation Check

Evidence (BF > 3) for differences between the Congruent and Mild and the Mild and Strong groups is taken as evidence that illusions functioned as intended (registered analysis).

```{r}
ttests <- data.frame()
for (outcome in c("ErrorRate", "IES")) {
    for (ill_type in c("Ebbinghaus", "MullerLyer", "VerticalHorizontal")) {
        for (cond in c("Congruent", "Mild")) {
            x1 <- ig_scores[[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_", cond, "_General")]]
            if (cond == "Congruent") {
                x2 <- ig_scores[[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_", "Mild_General")]]
            } else {
                x2 <- ig_scores[[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_", "Strong_General")]]
            }

            complete <- complete.cases(x1, x2)
            x1 <- x1[complete]
            x2 <- x2[complete]

            if (length(x1) < 2) {
                message(paste("Skipping:", outcome, ill_type, cond, "- not enough observations"))
                next
            }

            ttests <- BayesFactor::ttestBF(x = x1, y = x2, paired = TRUE) |>
                parameters::parameters() |>
                mutate(
                    Outcome = outcome,
                    Illusion_Type = ill_type,
                    Condition_Illusion = cond
                ) |>
                rbind(ttests)
        }
    }
}

ttests |>
    select(Illusion_Type, Condition_Illusion, Outcome, Median, BF) |>
    arrange(Illusion_Type, Condition_Illusion, Outcome) |>
    format_table() |>
    gt::gt()
```

## Reliability

### PCS

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Registered Sample (main analysis)

```{r}
data_ppt[, pcs_items] |>
    psych::alpha()
```

#### Unregistered Sample (sensitivity analysis)

```{r}
data_ppt_unreg[, pcs_items] |>
    psych::alpha()
```

#### Space Bar Check

Participants were instructed (PCS item 10, post-session suggestion) to press the space bar six times when "PLEASE WAIT" appeared, and to forget having been told to do so. This compares participants who failed the space bar check (fewer than 5 presses) with those who passed it, in the sample in which the check was not applied. If failures reflected general inattention, participants who failed should score lower on the other PCS items. The comparison score excludes item 10, which is computed from the urge and amnesia ratings.

```{r}
data_ppt_unreg$PCS_Score_NoItem10 <- rowMeans(data_ppt_unreg[, setdiff(pcs_items, "pcs_postsessionsuggetsion")], na.rm = TRUE)

table(Presses = data_ppt_unreg$pcs_press)

press_table <- data_ppt_unreg |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    Zero_Presses = sum(pcs_press == 0),
    Urge = mean(pcs_urgepress),
    Amnesia = mean(pcs_memorypress),
    PCS_OtherItems_Mean = mean(PCS_Score_NoItem10),
    PCS_OtherItems_SD = sd(PCS_Score_NoItem10),
    .by = PCS_Outlier_Press
  )
saveRDS(press_table, "figures/table_spacebar.rds")

press_table |>
  format_table() |>
  gt::gt()

bf_press <- BayesFactor::ttestBF(
  formula = PCS_Score_NoItem10 ~ PCS_Outlier_Press,
  data = mutate(data_ppt_unreg, PCS_Outlier_Press = as.factor(PCS_Outlier_Press))
)
bf_press
```

## Correlations

The fully registered analysis (main analysis) includes `r report::report_participants(data_ppt, age="Age", sex="Sex", education="Education")`, for a total trial number of `r nrow(data_ig)`. The unregistered analysis (sensitivity analysis) includes `r report::report_participants(data_ppt_unreg, age="Age", sex="Sex", education="Education")`, for a total trial number of `r sum(!data_ig_unreg$RT_Outlier)` after removing extreme trials (and minus participants excluded per illusion by the HDI exclusion).

Bayesian correlations use the *BayesFactor* medium prior (r-scale = 1/3), as registered. BF~10~ ≤ 1/3 is interpreted as evidence for the null (H0), BF~10~ ≥ 3 as evidence for a relationship (H1), and values in between as inconclusive.

```{r}
make_cor <- function(data, scores) {
  features <- merge(scores, data[c("Participant", "PCS_Score", "PID5_Psychoticism")])

  correlation::correlation(
    dplyr::select(features, -Participant, -PCS_Score, -PID5_Psychoticism),
    dplyr::select(features, PCS_Score, PID5_Psychoticism),
    bayesian = TRUE,
    bayesian_prior = "medium" # r-scale = 1/3 in BayesFactor::correlationBF()
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Evidence = dplyr::case_when(
      BF <= 1/3 ~ "H0",
      BF >= 3 ~ "H1",
      .default = "Inconclusive"
    ))
}

cor_table <- function(rez) {
  rez |>
    dplyr::arrange(desc(BF)) |>
    format_table() |>
    dplyr::mutate(BF = as.numeric(BF),
                  Parameter2 = str_remove_all(Parameter2, "_Score|PID5_")) |>
    dplyr::select(-Prior, -Method, -`% in ROPE`) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::data_color(
      columns = BF,
      fn = function(bf) dplyr::case_when(
        bf >= 10   ~ "green",
        bf >= 3    ~ "lightgreen",
        bf <= 1/10 ~ "red",
        bf <= 1/3  ~ "#ffabab",
        .default   = "white"
      )
    )
}

rez <- lapply(names(analysis_scores), function(a) {
  make_cor(if (a %in% c("Fully registered", "Registered, native English speakers only")) data_ppt else data_ppt_unreg, analysis_scores[[a]])
})
names(rez) <- names(analysis_scores)
```

### Registered Tests

The registered tests are the correlations between each trait and each illusion-sensitivity score, where Mild and Strong are collapsed or kept separate according to the registered decision rule (see above).

```{r}
registered_tests <- function(rez, vars) {
  rez |>
    filter(Parameter1 %in% vars) |>
    separate(Parameter1, into = c("Outcome", "Illusion", "Condition", "Difficulty"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      Trait = ifelse(Parameter2 == "PCS_Score", "PCS", "Psychoticism"),
      Outcome = recode(Outcome, "ErrorRate" = "Error rate", "IES" = "IES"),
      Illusion = recode(Illusion, "MullerLyer" = "Müller-Lyer", "VerticalHorizontal" = "Vertical–Horizontal"),
      Condition = recode(Condition, "Incongruent" = "Mild + Strong")
    ) |>
    select(Trait, Outcome, Illusion, Condition, rho, CI_low, CI_high, BF, n_Obs, Evidence) |>
    arrange(Trait, Outcome, Illusion, Condition)
}

tests <- lapply(names(rez), function(a) registered_tests(rez[[a]], registered_vars(decisions[[a]])))
names(tests) <- names(rez)

saveRDS(tests[["Fully registered"]], "figures/table_correlations_registered.rds")
saveRDS(tests[["Unregistered"]], "figures/table_correlations_unregistered.rds")

bind_rows(tests[c("Fully registered", "Unregistered")], .id = "Analysis") |>
  mutate(
    rho = insight::format_value(rho, zap_small = TRUE),
    `95% CI` = insight::format_ci(CI_low, CI_high, ci = NULL),
    BF = insight::format_bf(BF, name = NULL)
  ) |>
  select(Analysis, Trait, Outcome, Illusion, Condition, rho, `95% CI`, BF, n = n_Obs, Evidence) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Analysis")
```

### Sensitivity Analyses

Number of registered tests supporting the null / inconclusive / supporting a relationship, for each version of the analysis. The first row is the main (fully registered) analysis and the second the unregistered sensitivity analysis. The next two rows apply one deviation to the registered analysis (native English speakers only; space bar check not applied), and the following rows remove (or replace) one deviation at a time from the unregistered analysis. The last row keeps Mild and Strong separate for all scores in the registered analysis (exploratory).

```{r}
summarise_tests <- function(t) {
  t |>
    summarize(
      Result = paste0(sum(Evidence == "H0"), " / ", sum(Evidence == "Inconclusive"), " / ", sum(Evidence == "H1")),
      .by = c(Trait, Outcome)
    ) |>
    mutate(Column = paste(Trait, "×", Outcome)) |>
    select(Column, Result) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = Column, values_from = Result) |>
    mutate(N = paste(unique(range(t$n_Obs)), collapse = "–"), .before = 1)
}

all_mildstrong <- names(ig_scores)[str_detect(names(ig_scores), "_(Mild|Strong)_General$")]
tests[["Registered, Mild and Strong not collapsed (exploratory)"]] <- registered_tests(rez[["Fully registered"]], all_mildstrong)

sensitivity_table <- bind_rows(lapply(tests, summarise_tests), .id = "Analysis")
saveRDS(sensitivity_table, "figures/table_sensitivity.rds")

# Test-by-test results of every version (Bayes factor table in the supplementary materials)
saveRDS(bind_rows(tests, .id = "Analysis"), "figures/table_sensitivity_tests.rds")

sensitivity_table |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_source_note("Cells: number of tests with BF10 ≤ 1/3 (H0) / inconclusive / BF10 ≥ 3 (H1).")
```

### Exploratory Analyses

Correlations in the registered analysis with variant scores, which are not part of the registered tests: (1) Mild and Strong analysed separately for all scores; and (2) outcomes computed separately for each difficulty level (Easy and Hard), for the Mild, Strong and collapsed (Mild + Strong) conditions.

```{r}
exploratory_vars <- c(
  "Mild and Strong separate" = "_(Mild|Strong)_General$",
  "Difficulty-specific (Easy and Hard)" = "_(Mild|Strong|Incongruent)_(Easy|Hard)$"
)
exploratory <- rez[["Fully registered"]] |>
  mutate(Trait = ifelse(Parameter2 == "PCS_Score", "PCS", "Psychoticism"))

bind_rows(lapply(names(exploratory_vars), function(v) {
  exploratory |>
    filter(str_detect(Parameter1, exploratory_vars[[v]])) |>
    summarize(
      n = n(),
      Null = sum(Evidence == "H0"),
      Inconclusive = sum(Evidence == "Inconclusive"),
      Relationship = sum(Evidence == "H1"),
      .by = Trait
    ) |>
    mutate(Variant = v, .before = 1)
})) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header("Number of exploratory correlations in each evidential category")

exploratory |>
  filter(Evidence == "H1", str_detect(Parameter1, paste(exploratory_vars, collapse = "|"))) |>
  select(Parameter1, Trait, rho, BF) |>
  format_table() |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header("Exploratory correlations providing evidence for a relationship")
```

## Figures

### Exclusion Flow Diagram

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9
#| dpi: 300

ex <- readRDS("figures/exclusion_counts.rds")
hdi_n <- sapply(hdi_cong$flags, length)
fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")

# Layout: main flow boxes in each column, exclusion boxes branching off to the right
lh <- 0.31 # height of one text line (y units)
pad <- 0.2 # vertical padding inside boxes
xL <- 2.0; xL_side <- 5.9   # registered column
xR <- 10.0; xR_side <- 13.9 # unregistered column
xC <- (xL + xR) / 2

box <- function(id, x, y, w, type, title, body = "") {
  n <- 1 + ifelse(body == "", 0, length(strsplit(body, "\n")[[1]]))
  tibble(id = id, x = x, y = y, w = w, h = n * lh + 1.6 * pad, type = type, title = title, body = body)
}

boxes <- bind_rows(
  box("raw", xC, 11.6, 3.6, "sample", "Recruited via Prolific",
      paste0("N = ", ex$n_raw, " (", fmt(ex$n_trials_raw), " trials)")),
  box("pcs", xR, 10.5, 3.6, "excluded", "Excluded: PCS checks",
      paste0("\"Hello\" not reported: n = ", ex$pcs_hello, "\n\"No balls\" reported: n = ", ex$pcs_balls)),
  box("pass2", xC, 9.4, 3.6, "sample", "Passed first two PCS checks", paste0("N = ", ex$n_after_pcs)),
  # Registered column
  box("press", xL_side, 7.5, 3.6, "excluded", "Excluded: space bar check", paste0("n = ", ex$pcs_press)),
  box("pass3", xL, 6.4, 3.6, "sample", "Passed all three PCS checks", paste0("N = ", ex$reg_n_pass)),
  box("ig_reg", xL_side, 4.9, 3.6, "excluded", "Excluded: Illusion Game",
      paste0("Error rate > 45% (block A): n = ", ex$reg_error_full, "\nMean RT > 4 SD: n = ", ex$reg_rt_full,
             "\nBlock B removed: n = ", ex$reg_half)),
  box("final_reg", xL, 1.1, 3.6, "analysed", "Registered analysis",
      paste0("(main analysis)\nN = ", ex$reg_n, "\n", fmt(ex$reg_trials), " trials")),
  # Unregistered column
  box("nopress", xR, 6.4, 3.6, "deviation", "Space bar check not applied",
      paste0("N = ", ex$n_after_pcs)),
  box("ig_unreg", xR_side, 4.9, 3.6, "excluded", "Excluded: Illusion Game",
      paste0("Error rate > 45% (block A): n = ", ex$error_full, "\nMean RT > 4 SD: n = ", ex$rt_full,
             "\nBlock B removed: n = ", ex$half)),
  box("after_ig", xR, 3.6, 3.6, "sample", "After Illusion Game exclusions",
      paste0("N = ", ex$n, " (", fmt(ex$trials), " trials)")),
  box("dev", xR_side, 2.25, 3.6, "deviation", "Excluded: deviations",
      paste0("RT < 0.2 s or > 5 s:\n", fmt(ex$trials_rt_outlier),
             " trials (", round(100 * ex$trials_rt_outlier / ex$trials, 2), "%)",
             "\nCongruent error rate > 97.5% HDI:",
             "\nMüller-Lyer n = ", hdi_n[["MullerLyer"]],
             "\nEbbinghaus n = ", hdi_n[["Ebbinghaus"]],
             "\nVertical–Horizontal n = ", hdi_n[["VerticalHorizontal"]])),
  box("final_unreg", xR, 1.1, 3.6, "analysed", "Unregistered analysis",
      paste0("(sensitivity analysis)\nN = ", paste(unique(range(ex$n - hdi_n)), collapse = "–"), " per illusion\n",
             fmt(ex$trials - ex$trials_rt_outlier), " trials*"))
)

b <- function(id) boxes[boxes$id == id, ]
top <- function(id) b(id)$y + b(id)$h / 2
bottom <- function(id) b(id)$y - b(id)$h / 2
left <- function(id) b(id)$x - b(id)$w / 2
y_split <- (bottom("pass2") + max(top("pass3"), top("press"))) / 2 + 0.25

# Connectors without arrowheads (trunk of each column and the split)
lines_df <- tribble(
  ~x, ~y, ~xend, ~yend,
  xC, bottom("pass2"), xC, y_split,
  xL, y_split, xR, y_split
)
# Arrows: downward flow and horizontal branches into the exclusion boxes
arrows_df <- tribble(
  ~x, ~y, ~xend, ~yend,
  xC, bottom("raw"), xC, top("pass2"),
  xC, b("pcs")$y, left("pcs"), b("pcs")$y,
  xL, y_split, xL, top("pass3"),
  xR, y_split, xR, top("nopress"),
  xL, b("press")$y, left("press"), b("press")$y,
  xL, bottom("pass3"), xL, top("final_reg"),
  xL, b("ig_reg")$y, left("ig_reg"), b("ig_reg")$y,
  xR, bottom("nopress"), xR, top("after_ig"),
  xR, b("ig_unreg")$y, left("ig_unreg"), b("ig_unreg")$y,
  xR, bottom("after_ig"), xR, top("final_unreg"),
  xR, b("dev")$y, left("dev"), b("dev")$y
)
# The PCS branch starts from the trunk, not from the box
arrows_df[2, "x"] <- xC

fills <- c("sample" = "white", "excluded" = "#FBE4E2", "deviation" = "#FFF3D1", "analysed" = "#DDEAF6")
borders <- c("sample" = "grey45", "excluded" = "#B5473F", "deviation" = "#C08B00", "analysed" = "#2B65A8")
legend_labels <- c("Registered exclusion", "Deviation from the registered protocol", "Analysed sample")

p_consort <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = lines_df, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(data = arrows_df, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.5,
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.18, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
  geom_rect(data = boxes, aes(xmin = x - w / 2, xmax = x + w / 2, ymin = y - h / 2, ymax = y + h / 2,
                              fill = type, color = type), linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = boxes, aes(x = x, y = y + h / 2 - pad, label = title),
            vjust = 1, size = 4.1, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 1) +
  geom_text(data = boxes, aes(x = x, y = y + h / 2 - pad - lh, label = body),
            vjust = 1, size = 3.9, lineheight = 1.05, color = "grey15") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fills, breaks = c("excluded", "deviation", "analysed"), labels = legend_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = borders, breaks = c("excluded", "deviation", "analysed"), labels = legend_labels) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.1, 15.8), ylim = c(0.1, 12.5), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(fill = NULL, color = NULL, caption = "* Before per-illusion exclusions.") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.55, "cm"), plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))

ggsave("figures/fig_consort.png", p_consort, width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
p_consort
```

### Correlations

```{r fig1}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 11
#| dpi: 300

plot_cor <- function(rez, title) {
  rez |>
    filter(str_detect(Parameter1, "_General$")) |>
    mutate(Trait = ifelse(Parameter2 == "PCS_Score", "Phenomenological Control", "Psychoticism")) |>
    separate(Parameter1, into = c("Measure", "Illusion", "Condition", "Difficulty"), sep = "_") |>
    mutate(Measure = recode(Measure, "ErrorRate" = "Error rate (primary)", "IES" = "IES (secondary)"),
           Illusion = recode(Illusion, "MullerLyer" = "Müller-Lyer", "VerticalHorizontal" = "Vertical–Horizontal"),
           Condition = recode(Condition, "Incongruent" = "Mild + Strong"),
           Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("Congruent", "Mild", "Strong", "Mild + Strong")),
           Label = format_bf(BF, stars = TRUE, protect_ratio = FALSE, digits = 2)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = rho, y = Illusion, color = Condition)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), size = 2.5) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 0.5, label = Label), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
              hjust = 1, size = 2.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Congruent" = "#2196F3", "Mild" = "darkorange", "Strong" = "red", "Mild + Strong" = "#7B1FA2"),
                       breaks = c("Mild + Strong", "Strong", "Mild", "Congruent")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.3, 0.5), breaks = seq(-0.3, 0.3, by = 0.1),
                       labels = c("-.30", "-.20", "-.10", "0", ".10", ".20", ".30")) +
    facet_grid(Measure ~ Trait) +
    labs(x = "Correlation (posterior median and 95% credible interval)", y = NULL, color = "Illusion strength",
         title = title,
         caption = "Note. Labels show BF10. ° BF10 ≤ 1/3 (evidence for the absence of a relationship); * BF10 ≥ 3, ** BF10 > 10, *** BF10 > 30 (evidence for a relationship).\n'Mild + Strong' = Mild and Strong collapsed, as per the registered decision rule. The Congruent condition is not a measure of illusion sensitivity and is shown for reference only.") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
          strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "italic"),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
          panel.spacing.y = unit(2.5, "lines"))
}

p <- plot_cor(rez[["Fully registered"]], "Correlation between Illusion Sensitivity and Dispositional Traits")
ggsave("figures/fig_correlations_registered.png", p, width = 10, height = 11, dpi = 300)

p_unreg <- plot_cor(rez[["Unregistered"]], "Correlation between Illusion Sensitivity and Dispositional Traits (unregistered analysis)")
ggsave("figures/fig_correlations_unregistered.png", p_unreg, width = 10, height = 11, dpi = 300)

p
```
